data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word ‘El’ (God) and ‘Adjuvare’ (help). The name Eladio signifies ‘God's helper’ or ‘God's gift.’. The name Eladio carries the meaning “God's helper” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Eladio usually hope their child will grow to embody god's helper and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_latin.name: Eladio
in_latin.long_meaning: Eladio est nomen Latinum a Eladio, nomine Graeco, quod significat 'nutrimentum' vel 'medicamentum', et 'utilitas' vel 'resultatio'. Eladio est nomen commune classico. Post conquestibus Babylonici, Eladio factum est nomen rarum. Nomen Eladio potest significare utilis et nutrimentum.

in_english.name: Eladio
in_english.long_meaning: Eladio is a Latin name derived from the Greek name Eladius, which means 'nourishment' or 'medicament', and 'utility' or 'result'. Eladio was a common name in classical times. After the Babylonian conquests, Eladio became a rare name. The name Eladio can symbolize utility and nourishment.
